script_note: One academic-local route selects OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv, Semantic Scholar, PubMed, or public Scholar providers by coverage. SerpApi Scholar is an explicit optional credentialed provider. academic_public.py reads selected public metadata and HTML evidence. Academic/Scholar share one academic-local packet with separate source_tasks; retain date scope and the complete candidate collection. DBLP is another source, not a new route. PDF acquisition/reading directly uses the existing Paper Reading leaf.
source_requirement: Discovery metadata and snippets locate papers; paper-brief and detailed claims require selected-paper sources, with the primary PDF or body for exact claims.
agent_rule: One academic task owns source-specific queries, continuation, candidates, selected reading and evidence. source_tasks retain every selected academic platform's restrictions; ranking never discards unselected candidates.
